title: The Combustion Engine
philosophicalAnchor: Four cylinders fire in harmony, each independent yet synchronized. True power comes not from blocking others but from concurrent execution where each process advances without halting the whole.
pythonConcept: asyncio, async def, await, asyncio.gather, coroutines, concurrency
briefDescription: Simulate a V4 Engine Control Unit where four cylinders run concurrently using asyncio, without blocking the main thread.
theoryPillar: asyncio enables concurrent execution without true parallelism through coroutines—functions that can pause and resume. await suspends the coroutine, allowing others to run on the same thread.
anchorPillar: In a 4-cylinder engine, cylinders operate concurrently but out of phase for smooth power delivery. Using time.sleep() blocks the entire event loop; asyncio.gather schedules coroutines to run concurrently.
triggerPillar: Using time.sleep() freezes the entire engine simulation. Cylinder 1 runs while cylinders 2, 3, and 4 are completely frozen. Real engines need concurrent non-blocking execution.
realityPillar: async def defines a coroutine. asyncio.run() starts the event loop. await asyncio.sleep() pauses without blocking. asyncio.gather() schedules multiple coroutines concurrently. Firing order offsets create realistic multi-cylinder timing.
